info.title: DiscAI client WhatsApp voice verification
info.description: Authenticated tenant admin session and CSRF. Separate database per tenant. No public phone input. First provider authorization is a platform prerequisite, not replaced by OTP. Request creation and verification use Twilio Senders API v2; no undocumented resend endpoint. Errors 63114/429 cause a conservative local 24-hour pause, not a provider deadline. Provider mutations never retry automatically.
